restaurant_name: ขจีธัญชินี คลินิกการแพทย์แผนไทย ภูเก็ต (Kageetunchinee thai traditional clinic phuket)
text: We saw reviews from friends who had been receiving treatment here for 3 years, so we decided to schedule an appointment today. Dr. Dao is very kind and patient, attentive and giving us her time. The clinic is clean, smells nice, and has relaxing soft music. Today we had two procedures: acupuncture and treatment for hip muscle pain. I could barely sit today, but after the doctor's treatment, it's much better and I'm very happy. I'm so glad I made the right decision to see this doctor. The price is very reasonable and friendly. I had two treatments for less than 1000 baht. This is where I'll be my long-term clinic. I highly recommend it. I wish everyone good health, and I wish Dr. Dao's clinic continued success, and that all those who come here recover completely. She is such a compassionate doctor. Thank you so much! 🙏🥹✨
